note: Background A/B tests (src/backgrounds.js). Variant A is always the background in use (BG in src/art-extra.js, from tools/art_extra.py) and is never changed by a test. A pack variant is a layered parallax background whose files and layer order come from its manifest (art/manifests/<pack>.json). build.py builds a pack in only when its manifest and every layer file it lists are committed; without them the variant does not exist and everyone sees A.
testsNote: tests.<bg key> (the bg of a region in world.json): variants maps a letter to a pack id; live: false = nobody is assigned a variant (A for all, ?ozadje=B previews B); live: true = each install gets one variant by share, kept in localStorage zg-ab. Turning live on is the Game Director's call.
packsNote: packs.<id>: manifest path, hideRoad (the pack brings its own ground, so the road strip of variant A is hidden), and runtime tuning per layer id. speed = how fast a tiling layer scrolls compared with the road while the party walks (1 = with the road, 0 = still); pan = how far a layer that does not tile moves across a region (1 = from the centre to its right edge); drift = steady sideways motion of a tiling layer in art pixels per second (negative = to the right), off under reduced motion. Layers that must stay together share a value: town and reflections (the mirror image), sky and sun-glint (the sun's road on the water). These are PROPOSED values tuned in the browser, not art specifications. A layer the manifest has but this list does not gets a speed from its depth, and the build says so.
